ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High; approximately 85% high-intensity (white/cream) pixels to 15% low-intensity (black/dark-brown) pixels concentrated along the perimeter and median notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central and inner regions are predominantly high-intensity white. Continuous low-intensity black banding is present along the trailing edge and tips. High-contrast dark mottling is clustered near the median notch and sporadically across the outer lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; calculated internal angle of approximately 42 degrees with a deep central depression relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes varying between 5-15 pixels along the continuous trailing boundary; visible jagged peaks at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate concavity observed along the trailing edge extending from the median notch to the outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-contrast, dark, roughly circular barnacle attachments localized on the anterior edges and distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertical and diagonal dark linear tracks visible against the white background of both lobes, particularly visible on the right lobe (viewer perspective).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense barnacle colonization at the extreme distal tips; dark pigmentation scarring concentrated at the base of the fluke near the peduncle connection.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive yellowish-brown pixel staining (likely bio-fouling) distributed across the central and lower regions of the white ventral surface.
